description: Use when you need news articles or headlines from the last 72 hours about a topic, company or person. Do not use for full article text, paywalled sources, non-English coverage or news older than 72 hours. Returns JSON with recent news articles matching keywords: headline, URL, source, publish time, authors, tone, image and the people and organizations named, from GDELT for 0.008 USDC per call. Typical response time 600 ms (p95). Category: Search.

domain.description: Only articles from this source domain, e.g. reuters.com

hours.description: How far back to look, in hours (1-72, 24 when omitted)

limit.description: Maximum articles to return (1-50, 20 when omitted)

query.description: Keywords to find in headlines, people and organizations, e.g. nvidia earnings (all words must match)

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

name: blackwood_news_search

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: News headlines search
